hero.title: One UI system. Every product.
hero.subtitle: LnhDesign ships our standard components through a shadcn registry: run one command and the source lands in your repo, yours to edit, with nothing locked in.

stats.caption: Counted live from the catalog, not hand-written.

problem.title: Why this exists
problem.subtitle: Two products, same shadcn base, zero reuse between them. Every new screen starts from scratch.

style.before: One style per repo, two different Buttons
style.after: One radix-mira style, locked in the tokens package

icons.before: lucide and hugeicons mixed, config lying about it
icons.after: lucide for everything in the registry

version.before: lucide ^1.9 and ^1.34 side by side; copy-paste breaks
version.after: Version floor declared on the registry item

channels.title: Two delivery channels
channels.subtitle: What must never differ gets version-locked. What should differ per product gets copied in and owned by the team.
channels.npmBody: Color tokens, tailwind preset, tsconfig, eslint config. Installed as a normal dependency; bump the version and everything follows.
channels.registryBody: Components, blocks, templates. The CLI copies source into your repo — readable, editable, no abstraction in between.

usage.title: How you use it
usage.step1Body: Add a registries block to your repo's components.json.
usage.step2Body: The CLI pulls registry and npm dependencies with it.
usage.step3Body: The code is yours now — no release cycle to wait on.

cta.title: Where to start
cta.body: Read the setup guide, or jump straight into the catalog.

footer.tagline: The shared UI system for our internal products.
